name: Anger Of God The
overview: The anger of God is portrayed in Scripture as a righteous and powerful response to human sin and rebellion, as seen in the judgment that brought destruction upon all flesh except Noah and those with him in the ark (Genesis 7:21-23). This divine wrath is not arbitrary but is provoked by continual disobedience and transgression, exemplified by the Israelites who attempted to enter the promised land in defiance after sinning, resulting in God's refusal to be among them and warning of defeat by their enemies (Numbers 14:40-42). God's anger, while just and severe, is also patient and can be averted through faith, confession, and repentance, underscoring His desire for restoration rather than ruin.
